deltas.current_value: Anchor Browser provides cloud-hosted Chromium instances optimised for AI agent use — anti-detect, persistent sessions, residential proxies, CAPTCHA handling. Founded 2023, YC W24. $2.6M seed disclosed. Distinct from Browserless by adding persistent-state + anti-detect optimised for AI-agent web workflows.
deltas.proposed_value: Secure Infrastructure for Computer Using AI agents - Deploy millions of browser agents to automate any web task. Faster, cheaper, and more reliable than human operations.

deltas.current_value: YC W24; $2.6M seed; cloud Chromium with anti-detect + persistent sessions; positioned specifically for AI-agent web workflows
deltas.proposed_value: Deploy millions of browser agents to automate any web task. Faster, cheaper, and more reliable than human operations.

deltas.current_value: Browserless is a headless-browser-as-a-service — managed Chromium / Playwright / Puppeteer endpoints for web scraping, screenshots, PDF generation, web automation. Increasingly used as substrate for browser-agent products. Founded 2017 by Joel Griffith. Bootstrapped + small seed. Distinct from Playwright OSS — Browserless ships managed Chromium farms with anti-bot circumvention.
deltas.proposed_value: Give AI agents a cloud browser that won't crash or get blocked. Connect over MCP, Puppeteer, or Playwright with stealth and Authenticated Profiles built in.

deltas.current_value: Managed Chromium/Playwright/Puppeteer endpoints; founded 2017 by Joel Griffith; bootstrapped + small seed; thousands of customers for web scraping + browser-agent infra
deltas.proposed_value: Bring your own agent and library, or run ours. Stealth, CAPTCHA, residential proxies, and authenticated profiles that persist and scale to thousands. Your agent gets in, and gets it done.

deltas.current_value: Coder.com (formerly Coder Technologies) provides enterprise self-hosted cloud development environments — VS Code Server + dev workspaces on K8s / VMs. $30M Series B 2021 (Redpoint + Founders Fund + Coatue). Founded 2017 by Kyle Carberry + Ammar Bandukwala. 2024 launched 'Coder AI' for agent-execution inside workspaces. Self-hostable AGPL OSS + commercial enterprise.
deltas.proposed_value: Give developers a secure, governed environment to run AI coding agents at scale. Self-hosted infrastructure with full control over agent permissions, audit logging, and compliance.

deltas.current_value: $30M Series B 2021 (Redpoint + Founders Fund + Coatue); founded 2017 by Kyle Carberry + Ammar Bandukwala; AGPL OSS; Coder AI 2024 for in-workspace agent execution; used by major enterprise platform teams
deltas.proposed_value: Coder powers secure, scalable development across key industries — automotive, finance, government, and technology — enabling faster builds, tighter compliance, and seamless AI adoption in enterprise-grade cloud environments.

deltas.current_value: Daytona is an open-source cloud development environment (CDE) platform — self-hostable alternative to Gitpod / GitHub Codespaces. 2024 added AI-agent sandbox tier for ephemeral agent code execution. Apache 2.0. Founded by ex-Atlas Antillia / Codeanywhere team (Ivan Burazin). $5M seed 2024 (RTP Global + others). Distinct from e2b / Modal by being self-hostable-first.
deltas.proposed_value: Deploy Al code with confidence using Daytona

deltas.current_value: Apache 2.0 OSS CDE; self-hostable; AI-sandbox tier for agent code execution 2024; $5M seed 2024 (RTP Global); founded 2024 by Ivan Burazin (ex-Codeanywhere)

e2b provides secure, ephemeral sandboxes (Firecracker microVMs) for AI agent code execution. Each sandbox spins up in <200ms with full Linux environment, Python/Node/etc preinstalled. Substrate for code-agent products including Anthropic Claude Code (artifacts run on e2b), Perplexity, You.com Search, Cognition Devin (partially), and Hugging Face Spaces. Apache 2.0 OSS + managed cloud. $13M Seed + Series A 2024 (Sunflower Capital + a16z).
deltas.proposed_value: The AI Agent Cloud. An isolated machine for every AI agent: run code, browse, use tools, pause, fork. In our cloud or your AWS, GCP, or Azure account. 100K+ teams, 2B+ sandboxes started.

deltas.current_value: $13M+ raised (seed 2023 + Series A Sept-2024; Sunflower Capital + a16z); Firecracker microVM-based; <200ms cold start; used by Anthropic, Perplexity, Hugging Face; Apache 2.0 OSS SDK
deltas.proposed_value: E2B runs the isolated machine your agent works on. You ship the agent. We run the infrastructure. Our cloud or yours.

deltas.current_value: Modal Labs ships a serverless container platform with first-class GPU support; Sandboxes feature (2024) adds ephemeral, AI-agent-friendly compute sandboxes. Founded 2021 by Erik Bernhardsson (ex-Spotify ML, author of Luigi + Annoy). $87M total raised through Series B (Lux Capital + Redpoint + Definition + Amplify). Used by major LLM apps for batch inference + agent code execution.
deltas.proposed_value: This page is a high-level guide to Sandboxes, secure containers for executing untrusted code on Modal. Sandboxes are useful for tasks like executing code generated by an LLM or isolating user-generated code.

deltas.current_value: $87M total raised (Series B Sept-2024 led by Lux Capital + Redpoint; $1.1B reported valuation); founded 2021 by Erik Bernhardsson (ex-Spotify ML); Sandboxes feature 2024; serverless GPU + container runtime
deltas.proposed_value: This page is a high-level guide to Sandboxes, secure containers for executing untrusted code on Modal. Sandboxes are useful for tasks like executing code generated by an LLM or isolating user-generated code.

deltas.current_value: StackBlitz's WebContainers technology — browser-native Node.js runtime running fully client-side via WASM. Powers Bolt.new (already in catalog) plus many browser-based AI dev experiences. Founded 2017 by Eric Simons + Albert Pai. $7M Series A 2022. Distinct from server-side sandboxes (e2b / Modal) by running entirely in-browser — zero cloud-execution latency.
deltas.proposed_value: Build the future of web based coding experiences, from interactive tutorials to instant production-ready dev environments.

deltas.current_value: $7M Series A 2022; founded 2017 by Eric Simons + Albert Pai; WebContainers tech powers Bolt.new + Stackblitz IDE; browser-native Node.js via WASM
deltas.proposed_value: From interactive tutorials to full-blown IDEs, build instant, interactive coding experiences backed by WebContainers: the trusted, browser-based runtime from StackBlitz .

deltas.current_value: Workato is the enterprise iPaaS (integration platform) leader — $200M+ ARR, $5.7B valuation 2021. 2023-24 launched Workato AI / Workbot AI with AI-agent workflow sandbox capability inside its automation runtime. Used by Slack-bot / automation customers for AI-augmented workflows. Distinct from pure agent frameworks (CrewAI / LangGraph) by being deeply enterprise-iPaaS-anchored.
deltas.proposed_value: Neutral control & execution platform for Enterprise AI

deltas.current_value: $200M+ ARR; $5.7B valuation Nov-2021 Series E (Battery Ventures + Insight + Altimeter); founded 2013 by Vijay Tella (ex-Oracle / TIBCO); Workato AI / Workbot AI 2023-24; 17,000+ enterprise customers
deltas.proposed_value: Neutral control & execution platform for Enterprise AI
